title: Playboy May 2006 Rebecca Romijn Ozzie Guillen Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, May 2006. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: 2006 Party College Rankings - Girls of the Top Ten Party Schools; Playmate Alison Waite of San Diego State University; 20Q with Rebecca Romijn; interview with champion manager Ozzie Guillen and an MLB preview; six awesome motorcycles; on the road with Dick Cheney; Nike's Phil Knight; Joyce Carol Oates.

Back cover: Three Olives vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
